cues: The leftover pyruvate goes back to the mesophyll and is turned into PEP again, at a cost of two more ATP.
So a C4 plant pays five ATP per carbon dioxide instead of three: thirty per glucose instead of eighteen.
On a hot, bright day it is well worth it.
